name: Palace of Westminster and Westminster Abbey including Saint Margaret’s Church
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: On the Thames in central London, the Gothic-style Houses of Parliament, rebuilt from 1840 on the site of medieval remains, stand beside Westminster Abbey. Every sovereign since the 11th century has been crowned in the abbey, and more than 3,300 people are buried there, including monarchs, scientists and the Unknown Warrior. Tiny St Margaret's Church sits between them.
